page.overview:
Who is Crakka?

Crakka was a Hutt who was the cousin of the fellow Hutt Jabba Desilijic Tiure, leader of the Hutt Clan. Crakka became estranged from Jabba after threatening to kill him. Several decades later, Crakka visited Jabba at his Palace on the desert planet Tatooine. During the visit Crakka brought Jabba a hunanetre for his menagerie; claiming it was an apology for the previous threat.

By 3 ABY, Crakka had interfered with the B'omarr Monks that patrolled Jabba's Palace on the desert planet Tatooine. The result of which led to Crakka meeting a fate that other members of Jabba's retinue described as worse than death and Jabba's majordomo Bib Fortuna writting a warning to the denizens of the palace in which he said that Crakka's fate should serve as a cautionary tale to not disturb the B'omarr Monks.

In 3 ABY, a thief named Kay Vess broke into Jabba's Palace in search of her Merqaal companion Nix who had been sold to Jabba. While at the palace Vess read a datapad which included Fortuna's warning about Crakka.

Crakka appeared in the fourth issue of the 2019 comic book miniseries Star Wars Adventures: Return to Vader's Castle written by Cavan Scott.
